checks.previewBuild: passed with existing dynamic-import and chunk-size warnings

browser.environment: actual components with synthetic-only preview; no real database or provider
observations: Selected all three observed threads and approved a synthetic batch; the second response was lost after the fixture recorded it.
Saved review showed one confirmed and two unresolved items with their original windows, reasons and page budgets.
Refresh thread progress retained the one-of-three saved review while current fixture progress showed two queued imports.
Full page reload and reopening restored the same one-of-three review and stored channel; no auto-submission occurred.
Retry saved requests resolved all three approvals; already confirmed requests were skipped by the tested outbox contract.
Initial channel approval with a lost response survived reload and resolved through its original request.

A separate thread batch explicitly rejected its second item after one confirmation. Clearing only that rejection preserved its confirmed and unsent siblings; retry resolved two confirmations and one cleared rejection.
A pending channel request remained visible but its retry button was disabled after synthetic role changed to viewer. Restoring owner authority allowed the original request to resolve.

limits: No hosted signed-in acceptance of the newly durable initial channel/thread forms in this milestone; prior backend contracts and recovery-screen acceptance are separate evidence.
Lock competition is tested through the storage/lock contract, not a real two-tab browser race.
Browser-local storage does not survive browser-data removal or move between devices. Existing requests already lost by older in-memory forms cannot be reconstructed.
Explicit database rejections can be cleared per item; uncertain and permission-denied outcomes retain their exact requests.
No production mutation, hosted schema change, provider request, credential change, scheduler or frontend deployment.
Live Slack and voicemail capture, continuous history, other source integrations and broader LEARN V1 remain incomplete.
